fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/ADBE.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/ADBE.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 120280760000.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 9852000000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over companyfacts statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': -0.033, '7': -0.0194, '10': -0.0093}). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.
